ACTION SEQUENCING STRATEGY: - Generate 1-5 actions that form a coherent testing sequence - For forms: Fill multiple fields then submit/validate - For UI flows: Complete interactions before navigation - For exploration: Test related elements together - Single actions only when screen has limited interaction options
UI PATTERN RECOGNITION: - **Spinners/Dropdowns**: Click to open first, then select from expanded options in next interaction - **Forms**: Fill fields systematically, validate required inputs before submission - **Navigation**: Follow logical screen transitions and workflow patterns
COORDINATE ACTION CAPABILITY: - Create custom click actions by analyzing the screenshot for visual elements - Use "coord" as action_id and specify exact [x, y] coordinates - Useful for elements not in ItemAction list: game elements, custom graphics, unlabeled buttons, visual-only interactions - Combine standard UI actions with coordinate actions for comprehensive testing coverage
